qualtdict: Generate Variable Dictionaries and Labelled Survey Data for 'Qualtrics' Surveys

Source: R/qualtdict-package.R
qualtdict-package.Rd

Generates Variable Dictionaries from 'Qualtrics' https://www.qualtrics.com/about/ survey metadata and applies those dictionaries to create Labelled Survey Data. This package is a metadata and labelled-export companion to 'qualtRics', which provides access to 'Qualtrics' survey data and metadata via the 'Qualtrics' API https://api.qualtrics.com/.
